author: Bobby Grayson
title: Validated on the translator's own corpus: 14/14 modules in elixir/src report translatable; over the 37 fixtures the walker flags exactly 3 of the 8 error fixtures and NO ok fixture (zero 'walker found blockers, translator accepted'), and the wrapper reproduces 7 of the 8 translator errors (error_no_pid is fixed by the --pid retry, by design). Fixed three walker false positives found this way: a one-field map type %{f: T} is an assoc list with a one-atom key (now a note), an atom-keyed map literal %{x: 0} is ambiguous with a record so it is only a blocker when the module declares no atom-keyed map type, and [h | t] in an expression was mislabelled 'local call |/2'
